algebraization_argument: The torus-localized source quotient is one finite degree-2880 field K_eta9, and the selected cubic Hensel branch is a place of that field.

The normalized marked-map equations are finite type over K_eta9. At the selected place their square chart has unit Jacobian, so its local factor is zero-dimensional and etale. Its residue field is therefore a finite algebraic extension of K_eta9, not a merely formal coefficient ring.

After adjoining the already algebraic first-H, four-H and frame generators, the graph-incidence entries lie in one finite extension L. Reduction of the frozen pivot map is invertible on the rank-126 incidence image, hence the same pivot map is invertible over L.

Fixing the 123 free coordinates to their exact canonical representatives and applying c_P=-(I_P)^(-1)I_F c_F emits one exact L-rational eta9 member. Linear uniqueness identifies its v_101 completion with the all-orders framed section.

The proper special-fiber certificates exclude a basepoint or critical point and prove coefficient rank three. Therefore the characteristic-zero member is smooth and finite flat of degree three; these properties survive every embedding L->C.

frontier.next_required_object: Evaluate the normalized affine B-sweep on the finite set of complex embeddings of this exact member, using the same source orbit and graph-Prym divisor; then apply the direct G3BD quotient certificate or the graph-normal obstruction.

theorem.name: FramedGraphPrymCharacteristicZeroAlgebraizationTheorem
theorem.statement: The exact degree-2880 q79 source field, the selected local coefficient bridge, the etale marked-map chart and the unit rank-126 incidence framing define one smooth finite-flat degree-three graph-Prym eta9 member over a finite number-field extension L. Its selected v_101 completion is exactly the previously emitted framed all-orders section. Every complex embedding of L yields a smooth finite-flat characteristic-zero member carrying the same algebraic graph-Prym divisor.
